channel.title: GATE Guide — free GATE 2027 guides
channel.description: Free GATE 2027 guides for CSE, ECE, CE, DA, EE and ME: syllabus, weightage, important topics and preparation, by MD ANISH AHAMAD.

item.title: GATE ECE 6-Month Study Plan: 26 Weeks Ordered by Counted Marks
item.description: A GATE ECE 6 month study plan in 26 weeks, with hours set by five counted EC papers, sections in order of marks and a yes-or-no milestone every phase.

item.title: How to Make GATE CSE Short Notes You Can Revise in a Day
item.description: How to build GATE CSE short notes you can revise in one day. What goes on a page, a page budget per subject, and a cycle that shrinks the notes before February.

item.title: Environmental Engineering for GATE CE 2027: Important Topics
item.description: GATE CE environmental engineering important topics from all sixteen papers of 2019 to 2026, the short formulae that carry it, and what is new in 2027.

item.title: GATE ME 2027 Manufacturing and IE Syllabus: Section 4 Rewritten
item.description: Section 4 of the GATE ME 2027 syllabus changed most, with 38 phrases new and 18 gone. Additive manufacturing, automation and the expanded PPC line explained.

item.title: GATE DA 2027 Syllabus Changes: What Changed from 2026
item.description: GATE DA 2027 syllabus changes, checked word by word against 2026. No phrase was added, removed or reworded. Here is the method and what it means for your plan.

item.title: GATE EE Previous Year Papers: How to Analyse and Use Them
item.description: How to use GATE EE previous year papers: sit them timed, count them by section and topic, and log every lost mark by cause, using the 2022 to 2026 papers.

item.title: Analog Circuits for GATE ECE 2027: Important Topics
item.description: GATE ECE analog circuits counted across five EC papers. 54 marks in 34 questions, the circuits that recur, the 2027 syllabus additions and a study order.

item.title: B+ Tree and Indexing Questions in GATE CSE: Order, Levels, Accesses
item.description: How GATE CSE asks B+ tree and indexing questions. Node order from block size, levels for N records, block accesses, dense vs sparse indexes and splits.

item.title: Water Resources Engineering for GATE CE 2027: Important Topics
item.description: GATE CE Water Resources Engineering important topics for 2027, from all sixteen papers of 2019 to 2026. Hydraulics, fluids, hydrology and irrigation.

item.title: GATE DA 2027 Preparation Strategy That Follows the Marks
item.description: A GATE DA preparation strategy built on counted marks from all three papers, securing the always-asked topics first, then the named-but-unset ones, then mocks.

item.title: GATE ME 2027 Topics Removed: Lagrange, Heisler and What Moved
item.description: Only two phrases left the GATE ME 2027 syllabus outright, Lagrange's equation and Heisler's charts. What moved, what lost its examples, and what not to cut.

item.title: GATE EE 2027 Exam Pattern and Marking Scheme
item.description: GATE EE 2027 exam pattern explained: 65 questions, 100 marks, 3 hours, General Aptitude at 15 marks, and how MCQ, MSQ and NAT questions are marked.

item.title: GATE ME 2027 New Topics: Transmissibility, PID, Boiling and More
item.description: Every topic newly named in the GATE ME 2027 syllabus, from transmissibility and PID control to boiling, combustion and six sigma, and how much to read.

item.title: GATE ECE Qualifying Marks and Cutoffs Explained
item.description: GATE ECE qualifying marks for 2024, 2025 and 2026 from the official cut-off pages, the formula that sets them, and how admission cutoffs differ.

item.title: GATE DA 2027 Exam Pattern and Marking Scheme
item.description: GATE DA exam pattern for 2027 explained, with 65 questions, 100 marks, the fixed 15-mark aptitude block, MCQ, MSQ and NAT counts, and negative marking rules.

item.title: Paging and TLB Questions in GATE CSE: Levels, Bits and EAT
item.description: How GATE CSE asks paging questions. Page-table size, number of levels, the address bit split, TLB effective access time, TLB reach and inverted page tables.

item.title: Geotechnical Engineering for GATE CE 2027: Important Topics
item.description: GATE CE Geotechnical Engineering important topics for 2027, counted from all sixteen papers of 2019 to 2026. The steadiest heavy section and what changed.

item.title: GATE EE 2027 Syllabus Changes: What Changed From 2026
item.description: GATE EE 2027 syllabus changes, checked word by word against 2026. No phrase added, removed or reworded; one spelling corrected. What that means for you.

item.title: Signals and Systems for GATE ECE 2027: Important Topics
item.description: GATE ECE signals and systems counted across five EC papers. 52 marks in 34 questions, the question families that recur, and what the 2027 syllabus newly names.

item.title: Hashing Questions in GATE CSE: Probing, Load Factor and Traps
item.description: How GATE CSE asks hashing questions. Separate chaining versus open addressing, linear and quadratic probing, double hashing, load factor and tombstones.
